question: after a one-hidden-layer MLP learns a structured task, how many additional BLINDED random associations can it fit before crossing a FROZEN original-task retention margin, conditional on the checkpoint — and is that endpoint predictable from parameter count or compressed length alone (H2 of the M3-M6 draft)
endpoint_semantics: the count of random associations that remain JOINTLY acquired under the frozen retention margin — a conditional empirical intervention result under this exact protocol; NEVER 'unused bits', 'remaining intelligence' or exact Kolmogorov complexity; sequential acquisition throughput is NOT the endpoint

cumulative_endpoint.evaluation: after adding batch b, evaluate the UNION of batches 0..b; the endpoint advances only when EVERY cumulative association meets the frozen per-association acquisition criterion AND the original-task retention criterion holds; once an earlier association is forgotten the endpoint cannot increase

rehearsal_rule.primary: balanced minibatches: 50% original-task examples and 50% uniformly sampled (with replacement) cumulative associations
rehearsal_rule.evaluation_cadence: once per batch: retention AND full cumulative acquisition

no_rehearsal_arm.multiplicity: descriptive; never part of the confirmatory family; frozen now — the better policy is never chosen after seeing intervention outcomes
no_rehearsal_arm.matched_minibatch: the no-rehearsal diagnostic processes the SAME frozen minibatch size AND the SAME number of examples per update as the primary arm (16 associations per update, no original-task examples); frozen before any intervention outcome

retention.metric: original-task evaluation loss on held-out rows of the training generator
retention.margin_rule: frozen at intervention start: retention violated when loss exceeds (1 + 0.10) * checkpoint loss on two consecutive evaluations
retention.violation_rule: 2 CONSECUTIVE failing evaluations at the frozen cadence; the streak resets to zero after a passing evaluation; raw losses and the streak are both published

task_families.generator_identity_rule: generator id = sha256(master|family|regime|role|instance); DEVELOPMENT, CALIBRATION and CONFIRMATION roles use DISJOINT instance ranges (0-15, 16-23, 24-31) and never share a generator id
task_families.generator_id_rule: readable `ROLE-family-noise-gN`; the ROLE enters the seed derivation; index namespaces are role-separated (byte-disjointness proven executable); the inherited sha-id/numeric-range text is superseded

architectures.output: linear regression head / sigmoid for boolean tasks

optimizer_capability_controls.rule: before any capacity claim, the SAME optimizer budget must first learn each structured family to its frozen learnability criterion on a clean development instance; a family that fails is typed OPTIMIZATION_LIMITED and its cells never become capacity evidence
optimizer_capability_controls.learnability_criterion: task metric within the family's frozen threshold on held-out rows of the SAME generator

association_batches.blinding: random input/label associations drawn from the sealed seed stream; batch contents never inspected before commitment

controls.random_initialization: an untrained matched-architecture model runs the identical intervention with matched compute
controls.matched_compute: the control EXECUTES the identical batch/update sequence; its update-count difference is derived from both ledgers and must be within 1%

statistics.unit: the task GENERATOR (never a checkpoint, seed or adjacent temporal sample)
statistics.nested_seeds: 3 model seeds nested per generator; reported as nested repetitions
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni over the frozen confirmatory contrast family; family list frozen before any confirmation outcome
statistics.missing_runs: typed states remain in the denominator; never silently dropped

measurements.cost_rule: every measurement's CPU cost is recorded per checkpoint and stays in the cost denominator

resources.single_limit_note: ONE executable hard wall — the reduction-rule ceiling and the enforced runner limit are the same 172800 s

question_v4: Conditional on a learned structured task, architecture and checkpoint, how many blinded random associations remain jointly acquired before the frozen retention rule fails, and do training measurements improve prediction of that endpoint beyond parameter count and checkpoint loss? The endpoint is an empirical intervention result under this protocol — never unused intelligence, free bits, exact information content or exact Kolmogorov complexity.

generator_roles.CALIBRATION: threshold freeze; outcomes not inspected in this order

candidate_population.unit_definition: the task GENERATOR is the independent unit; model seeds and checkpoints are nested repetitions

population_census.meaningful_products_rule: Boolean and control families admit only `clean`; the five noise regimes apply to the five temporal observation processes — 4 + 5x5 = 29 structured cells; nonsensical products REFUSE in the generator bank
population_census.note: the full Cartesian product is NOT assumed affordable; the reduction rule above is frozen before outcomes and preserves every primary family, both informative widths and the primary checkpoint pair

estimands.primary_endpoint: RESTRICTED acquired count min(cumulative associations at last passing evaluation, 512) over 64 batches; a cap hit is the observed restricted value WITH CAP_REACHED published; WALL_STOP/RSS_STOP/STOP_REQUESTED/numerical failure/interruption are INCOMPLETE scientific units — in the denominator, never survival censoring; no unrestricted secondary analysis is retained in v5 and the undefined Gehan fallback is removed
estimands.analysis_1_intervention_effect: within-generator paired difference between the calibration_stop checkpoint and a matched random initialization under identical association batches and compute
estimands.analysis_2_checkpoint_effect: paired contrasts among the four checkpoints within (generator, width, model seed); checkpoints are NEVER treated as independent
estimands.analysis_3_incremental_prediction: out-of-generator prediction of log1p(endpoint): (M0) parameter count; (M1) M0 + checkpoint loss + elapsed updates; (M2) M1 + frozen trajectory and description measurements — M2 advances only if it improves unseen-generator error AND calibration after its measurement cost is included
estimands.descriptor_status: compressed length, pruning and spectral rank are candidate DESCRIPTORS, not ground truth; repeated weights do not imply remaining capacity
estimands.m3_status: prior evidence only — never a training sample for M4

criterion.temporal: held-out MSE skill vs frozen baseline

learnability_gate.threshold_rule: margin = max(0.05, p95 of the random_label control's improvement-over-baseline across widths and DEVELOPMENT generators); estimated on DEVELOPMENT, to be FROZEN on CALIBRATION before any confirmation outcome
controls: random_initialization band (3 extra inits evaluated without updates)
learnability_gate.gate_rule: only LEARNABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_BUDGET enters the capacity intervention; missing/failed cells stay in the denominator; a primary family failing at every width is reported as a limitation and never reinterpreted; budgets are never increased after seeing confirmation behavior

confirmatory_contrast_family.multiplicity: Bonferroni-bounded design basis; Holm step-down at analysis time
confirmatory_contrast_family.heterogeneity_rule: family-specific effects reported ALWAYS; pooling only if the family-effect interquartile range is below half the smallest effect of interest

precision.method: paired one-sample t on generator-level differences, Bonferroni-adjusted alpha, Monte Carlo with Lentz incomplete-beta p-values

reduction_rule.rule: confirmatory grid = every primary family x widths {16, 64} x temporal noise {clean, white} x checkpoint pair (initialization, calibration_stop) x 3 nested seeds; frozen BEFORE developmental outcomes
reduction_rule.affordability_check: runtime per run is MEASURED by the four development units of this order; N* generators from the precision table times measured runtime must fit the declared ceiling or the return is M4_CONFIRMATORY_POPULATION_INSUFFICIENT

four_unit_rule.rule: exactly four end-to-end DEVELOPMENT intervention units, chosen pre-outcome for family/width/noise diversity; runtime and mechanics only — endpoints never tune the protocol
four_unit_rule.checkpoint: calibration_stop vs initialization control + one matched diagnostic batch

v4_to_v5_field_map.task_families: canonical spelling `discontinuity`; one readable role-namespaced id rule replaces the inherited sha/numeric-range text (F-additional-1)
v4_to_v5_field_map.architectures: Boolean head is EXECUTED sigmoid+BCE (was declared sigmoid, ran linear/MSE — F3)
v4_to_v5_field_map.resources: ONE executable hard wall 172800 s (48 h) replaces the contradictory 21600 s (F-additional-10)
v4_to_v5_field_map.association_tape: arm/checkpoint-free identity, family-compatible marginals, blinded pairing (F1/F4)
v4_to_v5_field_map.genesis: one genesis per (generator,width,seed); initialization IS that object (F2)
v4_to_v5_field_map.checkpoints: four real materialized lineages with frozen stopping rule (F2)
v4_to_v5_field_map.baselines: train-selected majority CLASS evaluated on EVALUATION rows (F3)
v4_to_v5_field_map.endpoint: restricted min(count, 64 batches) primary; CAP_REACHED typed; resource stops are INCOMPLETE units, never censoring; the undefined Gehan fallback is REMOVED and no unrestricted secondary analysis is retained (C31)
v4_to_v5_field_map.populations: DEV 2 / CAL 16 / CONF 48 reserved per cell; role inside seed derivation (C29)
v4_to_v5_field_map.ladder: executable discrete-time survival M0/M1/M2, frozen ridge lambda 1.0, generator-grouped splits, integrated Brier + horizon calibration (C30)

data_roles.EVALUATION: learnability, retention and scientific endpoints only (64 rows)
data_roles.binding: all six arrays digest-bound in the generator manifest; no EVALUATION value may select a checkpoint, threshold, width, seed or budget

checkpoint_rules.genesis: one _mlp_init per (generator,width,model_seed); arm and checkpoint names never enter the derivation
checkpoint_rules.initialization: the genesis object itself, zero updates

calibration_stop.rule: best STOP-slice loss under frozen cadence/patience/min-delta

checkpoint_rules.pre_stop: the snapshot at half the selected stopping update, floored to the cadence (min one cadence point)
checkpoint_rules.post_stop_bounded: exactly 500 additional TRAIN-only updates from calibration_stop
checkpoint_rules.lineage: parameter digests, update counts, STOP-trajectory digest and parent digests persisted; the verifier replays each lineage

association_tape.identity: tape::<design16>::<generator_id>::wW::sS — arm and checkpoint names excluded
association_tape.inputs: Boolean: fresh ±1 draws of the same input process; temporal: disjoint windows of the same observation process
association_tape.targets: independent blinded draw from the family's TRAIN target distribution

acquisition_tolerance.fitting: temporal tolerance = multiple x TRAIN target SD (train-fitted, frozen in the tape)

association_tape.digest: persisted and re-derived; one byte of difference between arms refuses before optimization

populations_v5.confirmation_boundary: 48 fixed BEFORE calibration; CONFIRMATION arrays and outcomes are never generated, loaded or scored in this order — structurally enforced
populations_v5.dispersion_rule: per confirmatory cell: paired restricted-endpoint difference (calibration_stop minus initialization) averaged over the 3 nested model seeds per generator; SD across the 16 CALIBRATION generators; 95% chi-square upper confidence bound; UCB > 6.0 associations returns M4_CONFIRMATORY_PRECISION_NOT_SUPPORTED

prediction_ladder.form: discrete-time survival over the 64 acquisition batches (logistic hazard, quadratic batch basis)
prediction_ladder.M1: M0 + checkpoint loss + elapsed task updates
prediction_ladder.M2: M1 + frozen trajectory (STOP-loss slope) and description (compressed length, spectral rank, prune fraction) measurements
prediction_ladder.decision: M2 advances only on paired unseen-generator integrated-Brier improvement after Holm within the frozen family AND calibration non-inferiority; measurement time and CPU cost reported separately
prediction_ladder.insufficiency: fewer than 4 generator groups returns a typed insufficiency instead of a fit
